name: Pro Product Catalog and Variant Manager
description: Spreadsheet-style catalog editor: virtualised TanStack grid with variant sub-rows (10k+), Cartesian variant generation from option chips, zod cell validation and duplicate-SKU checks, range select, fill-down, Excel paste, bulk percent/fixed price changes, undo/redo and a dirty-state save bar.

props.name: products
props.description: Saved catalog (products with options and variants); a new reference resets the editor

props.name: onSave
props.description: Persist edits; resolve to mark them saved, reject to keep them dirty and show the error

props.name: onChange
props.description: Working copy after every edit, undo or redo

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a skeleton instead of the grid

props.name: error
props.description: Load error shown in place of the grid
